[32-bit] Boot disc and region (read-only)
First entry of a jump table in the game's code, not a variable. Never written at runtime.
Shows which disc's program is running and the region; RAM addresses depend on both.
0x8001622C = USA, booted from disc 1
0x80016230 = USA, booted from disc 2 or 5
0x8001624C = USA, booted from disc 3 or 4
0x8001BD7C = Europe/Germany, booted from disc 1
0x8001BD80 = Europe/Germany, booted from disc 2 or 5
0x8001BD9C = Europe/Germany, booted from disc 3 or 4
0x800161F4 = France, booted from disc 1
0x800161F8 = France, booted from disc 2 or 5
0x80016214 = France, booted from disc 3 or 4
0x8001617C = Japan, booted from disc 1
0x80016180 = Japan, booted from disc 2 or 5
0x8001619C = Japan, booted from disc 3 or 4

[8-bit] Europe/Germany language (read-only)
Character in the memory card file name string ("BESLES-00963" / "BESLES-01100"), not a variable.
Only meaningful when 0x010700 shows Europe/Germany.
0x30 = Europe (English)
0x31 = Germany

[8-bit] Boot disc layout (USA, read-only)
Low byte of an instruction operand in the game's code at 0x800146a8, not a variable.
Shows which disc's program is running. It stays loaded after disc swaps, and RAM addresses depend on it.
0x28 = Booted from disc 1
0x2C = Booted from disc 2 or 5, globals +0x04
0x48 = Booted from disc 3 or 4, globals +0x20
